package vparquet4

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"sort"
	"testing"

	"github.com/gogo/protobuf/proto"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb"
	cv "github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb/common/v1"
	rv "github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb/resource/v1"
	tv "github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb/trace/v1"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/traceql"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/util"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/tempodb/backend"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/tempodb/encoding/common"
)

// Optional public-source oracle. Raw block dictionaries are recorded separately
// from complete, unambiguous roots over actual engine-selected trace IDs.
func TestPulseRoots(t *testing.T) {
	dir := "/tmp/pulse-root-discovery"
	if e := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0755); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	attr := func(k, v string) *cv.KeyValue {
		return &cv.KeyValue{Key: k, Value: &cv.AnyValue{Value: &cv.AnyValue_StringValue{StringValue: v}}}
	}
	id := func(n uint64, w int) []byte { b := make([]byte, w); binary.BigEndian.PutUint64(b[w-8:], n); return b }
	labels := []string{"normal", "duplicate", "missing", "unknownservice", "ambiguous", "childlink", "empty", "parentflip"}
	all := &tempopb.Trace{}
	rows := []*Trace{}
	for i, label := range labels {
		tid := id(uint64(i+1), 16)
		makeOwner := func(sid uint64, parent []byte, name, service string) *tv.ResourceSpans {
			attrs := []*cv.KeyValue{}
			if service != "<missing>" {
				attrs = append(attrs, attr("service.name", service))
			}
			sp := &tv.Span{TraceId: tid, SpanId: id(sid, 8), ParentSpanId: parent, Name: name, StartTimeUnixNano: uint64(i+1)*1_000_000_000 + sid, EndTimeUnixNano: uint64(i+1)*1_000_000_000 + sid + 100, Attributes: []*cv.KeyValue{attr("case", label)}}
			return &tv.ResourceSpans{Resource: &rv.Resource{Attributes: attrs}, ScopeSpans: []*tv.ScopeSpans{{Spans: []*tv.Span{sp}}}}
		}
		rootName, rootService := "GET /api", "gateway"
		if label == "unknownservice" {
			rootService = "<missing>"
		}
		if label == "empty" {
			rootName = ""
			rootService = ""
		}
		root := makeOwner(1, nil, rootName, rootService)
		child := makeOwner(2, id(1, 8), "work", "worker")
		if label == "normal" {
			child.ScopeSpans[0].Spans[0].StartTimeUnixNano = 20_000_000_000
			child.ScopeSpans[0].Spans[0].EndTimeUnixNano = 20_000_000_100
		}
		owners := []*tv.ResourceSpans{root, child}
		switch label {
		case "duplicate":
			owners = append(owners, proto.Clone(root).(*tv.ResourceSpans))
		case "missing":
			owners = owners[1:]
		case "ambiguous":
			owners = append(owners, makeOwner(3, nil, rootName, rootService))
		case "childlink":
			root.ScopeSpans[0].Spans[0].Links = []*tv.Span_Link{{TraceId: id(100, 16), SpanId: id(100, 8), Attributes: []*cv.KeyValue{attr("opentracing.ref_type", "child_of")}}}
		case "parentflip":
			owners = append(owners, makeOwner(1, id(99, 8), rootName, rootService))
		}
		all.ResourceSpans = append(all.ResourceSpans, owners...)
		row, _ := traceToParquet(&backend.BlockMeta{}, tid, &tempopb.Trace{ResourceSpans: owners}, nil)
		rows = append(rows, row)
	}
	wire, e := proto.Marshal(all)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	if e = os.WriteFile(dir+"/input.protobuf", wire, 0644); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	block := makeBackendBlockWithTraces(t, rows)
	opts := common.DefaultSearchOptions()
	engine := traceql.NewEngine()
	queries := []string{`{}`}
	for _, label := range append(labels, "absent") {
		queries = append(queries, fmt.Sprintf(`{span.case="%s"}`, label))
	}
	queries = append(queries, `{resource.service.name="worker" && span.case=~"norm.*"}`)
	cases := []map[string]any{}
	consumed := 0
	for _, target := range []string{"rootName", "trace:rootName", "rootServiceName", "trace:rootService"} {
		for _, q := range queries {
			tag, e := traceql.ParseIdentifier(target)
			if e != nil {
				t.Fatal(e)
			}
			rawSet := map[tempopb.TagValue]bool{}
			fetch := traceql.NewTagValuesFetcherWrapper(func(ctx context.Context, r traceql.FetchTagValuesRequest, cb traceql.FetchTagValuesCallback) error {
				return block.FetchTagValues(ctx, r, cb, func(uint64) {}, opts)
			})
			if e = engine.ExecuteTagValues(context.Background(), tag, q, traceql.MakeCollectTagValueFunc(func(v tempopb.TagValue) bool { rawSet[v] = true; return false }), fetch); e != nil {
				t.Fatal(e)
			}
			found, e := engine.ExecuteSearch(context.Background(), &tempopb.SearchRequest{Query: q + " with (most_recent=true)", Limit: 1000, SpansPerSpanSet: 1000}, traceql.NewSpansetFetcherWrapper(func(ctx context.Context, r traceql.FetchSpansRequest) (traceql.FetchSpansResponse, error) {
				return block.Fetch(ctx, r, opts)
			}))
			if e != nil {
				t.Fatal(e)
			}
			selected := map[string]bool{}
			for _, tr := range found.Traces {
				if tr.SpanSet.Matched != uint32(len(tr.SpanSet.Spans)) {
					t.Fatal("clipped fixture")
				}
				selected[tr.TraceID] = true
			}
			grouped := map[string][]*tv.ResourceSpans{}
			for _, owner := range all.ResourceSpans {
				sp := owner.ScopeSpans[0].Spans[0]
				key := util.TraceIDToHexString(sp.TraceId)
				if selected[key] {
					grouped[key] = append(grouped[key], owner)
				}
			}
			conflict, unknown := false, false
			completeSet := map[tempopb.TagValue]bool{}
			serviceTarget := target == "rootServiceName" || target == "trace:rootService"
			for _, owners := range grouped {
				flags := map[string]bool{}
				rootID := ""
				rootName := ""
				rootService := ""
				known := true
				for _, owner := range owners {
					sp := owner.ScopeSpans[0].Spans[0]
					root := len(sp.ParentSpanId) == 0
					for _, link := range sp.Links {
						for _, a := range link.Attributes {
							if a.Key == "opentracing.ref_type" && a.Value.GetStringValue() == "child_of" {
								root = false
							}
						}
					}
					sid := util.SpanIDToHexString(sp.SpanId)
					if prior, ok := flags[sid]; ok && prior != root {
						conflict = true
					}
					flags[sid] = root
					if !root {
						continue
					}
					service := ""
					present := false
					for _, a := range owner.Resource.Attributes {
						if a.Key == "service.name" {
							if v, ok := a.Value.Value.(*cv.AnyValue_StringValue); ok {
								service = v.StringValue
								present = true
							}
						}
					}
					if rootID != "" && (rootID != sid || rootName != sp.Name || rootService != service) {
						conflict = true
					}
					if rootID == "" {
						rootID = sid
						rootName = sp.Name
						rootService = service
					}
					known = known && present
				}
				if rootID == "" || (serviceTarget && !known) {
					unknown = true
					continue
				}
				value := rootName
				if serviceTarget {
					value = rootService
				}
				completeSet[tempopb.TagValue{Type: "string", Value: value}] = true
			}
			sorted := func(set map[tempopb.TagValue]bool) []*tempopb.TagValue {
				v := []*tempopb.TagValue{}
				for p := range set {
					p := p
					v = append(v, &p)
				}
				sort.Slice(v, func(i, j int) bool { return v[i].Value < v[j].Value })
				return v
			}
			c := map[string]any{"target": target, "query": q, "raw": map[string]any{"tagValues": sorted(rawSet)}}
			errorName := ""
			if conflict {
				errorName = "trace_root_conflict"
			} else if unknown {
				errorName = "trace_root_unknown"
			}
			complete := sorted(completeSet)
			if errorName != "" {
				c["expected_error"] = errorName
			} else {
				c["complete"] = map[string]any{"tagValues": complete}
			}
			cases = append(cases, c)
			if errorName != "" {
				continue
			}
			for _, version := range []int{1, 2} {
				b, e := os.ReadFile(fmt.Sprintf("%s/value-%02d-v%d.protobuf", dir, len(cases)-1, version))
				if os.IsNotExist(e) && os.Getenv("PULSE_REQUIRE_CONSUMER") != "1" {
					continue
				}
				if e != nil {
					t.Fatal(e)
				}
				if version == 2 {
					got := &tempopb.SearchTagValuesV2Response{}
					if e = proto.Unmarshal(b, got); e != nil {
						t.Fatal(e)
					}
					if !proto.Equal(got, &tempopb.SearchTagValuesV2Response{TagValues: complete}) {
						t.Fatal("v2 mismatch")
					}
				} else {
					got := &tempopb.SearchTagValuesResponse{}
					if e = proto.Unmarshal(b, got); e != nil {
						t.Fatal(e)
					}
					want := []string{}
					for _, v := range complete {
						want = append(want, v.Value)
					}
					if !proto.Equal(got, &tempopb.SearchTagValuesResponse{TagValues: want}) {
						t.Fatal("v1 mismatch")
					}
				}
				consumed++
			}
		}
	}
	data, e := json.MarshalIndent(cases, "", "  ")
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	if e = os.WriteFile(dir+"/oracle.json", append(data, '\n'), 0644); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	t.Logf("%d actual public consumer messages", consumed)
}
